connectors.title: Connector health
connectors.gate: Connector health is not simulated. QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage require their documented adapters, keychain flow, rate limiting, and registered connector handlers.

tools.title: Source controls
tools.vaultGate: Blocked: no compliant compressed SQLite-payload mutation, checkpoint, and atomic authenticated Company-container reseal lifecycle exists. OneFP&A will not write plaintext or sidecar source copies.
tools.reconciliationGate: reconcile.run is catalogued but has no typed bridge schema or registered Rust handler.
tools.progressGate: The current import.parse command emits no typed import:progress event and exposes no cancel command; no percentage or Cancel action is fabricated.

importHub.localOnly: Manual parsing uses the local Rust core in the desktop build. Browser development uses the explicitly dev-only mock; production never routes this workflow through the mock.

source.title: Parsed source

editor.noHeaders: The parser returned no source headers. Re-export the file with a header row.

normalization.title: Normalization rules

preview.title: Source preview
preview.unavailable: Mapped row preview begins after a mapping is selected and validation runs.
preview.gate: import.parse does not expose raw source rows. The mapped preview is derived only from valid rows returned by import.validate.

empty.noParse: No parsed source is available. Parse a file in Import Hub first.
empty.noCompany: Open a Company and parse a source before mapping.

ready.title: Mapping is ready for validation
ready.description: Run the registered import.validate command to resolve periods, accounts, business units, currencies, and exact minor-unit amounts while preserving explicitly normalized dimension text.
ready.noWrite: Validation is read-only: it does not create an Import Batch or commit source rows.
ready.readOnly: Validation remains available in read-only mode because it does not write or alter audit history.

loading.title: Validating mapped rows…
loading.description: OneFP&A is resolving Company-scoped targets and applying HARD and WARNING rules.

error.title: Validation could not be completed
error.fallback: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

outcome.blockedDescription: HARD findings must be corrected in the source or mapping before Tie-Out. Valid mapped rows are still previewed separately.
outcome.emptyDescription: The source produced no valid mapped rows and no preview. Return to the Import Hub to inspect and re-parse the source.
outcome.cleanDescription: No HARD or WARNING findings were returned for the valid mapped rows.
outcome.warningDescription: There are no HARD findings. Review every WARNING before the later Tie-Out and commit stages.

hard.title: HARD findings ({{count}})
hard.description: A HARD finding blocks Tie-Out and commit. Row findings name the physical source row; batch findings apply to the full source.
hard.label: Blocking validation findings

warning.title: WARNING findings ({{count}})
warning.description: A WARNING does not make a row invalid, but it must be reviewed before commit.
warning.label: Validation warnings

findings.more: {{count}} more findings are not rendered here to keep the screen responsive. The summary count includes them.

preview.title: Valid mapped row preview
preview.description: Showing {{shown}} of up to the first 50 valid mapped rows ({{rows}} valid rows total). Invalid source rows appear only as HARD findings.
preview.caption: First valid mapped rows returned by import.validate
preview.emptyDescription: Validation returned zero valid mapped rows. Raw source rows are not fabricated on this screen.

remediation.title: Next action
remediation.description: Edit the mapping, or return to the Import Hub to correct and re-parse the source. Then run validation again.
remediation.unsupported: This screen does not create accounts, remap individual rows, or acknowledge warnings. Explicit exclusions and Import Batch commit are handled only by the next registered Tie-Out surface.
remediation.hardGate: Tie-Out is blocked while HARD findings remain. No Tie-Out call was made.
remediation.emptyGate: Tie-Out is blocked because there are no valid mapped rows to commit.
remediation.tieOutReady: Validation passed its HARD gate. Continue to the authoritative Tie-Out and Import Batch commit surface.

importCommit.title: Tie-Out & Commit

exclusions.title: Attributable difference rows

exclusions.authoritative: The commit engine reapplies these exclusions by physical source row and reruns exact Tie-Out. No adjusted total is calculated in the browser.
